title: Execution Liveness, Frontier Reconciliation & Stall Visibility Repair
owner_directive: Repair stale roadmap/frontier state under OPS3; preserve three parallel persistent implementation lanes; prevent an active main holder from silently sleeping; make no-progress Continue cycles visibly stalled instead of indefinitely repeating.

repair_scope: Restore MNCS terminal truth through MNCS-24 and retain PR 616 only as a post-completion corrective amendment.

Preserve product-development, ui-implementation and player-species as three independent persistent implementation lanes; preserve MVPS-10 selection.
Upgrade FIFO semantics to schema 2.1 bounded liveness with non-cosmetic progress receipts and safe stalled-turn recovery.
Remove the repository-health workflow's direct-to-main generated-content push; generated drift now fails closed on the candidate.
Upgrade execution guard with material-progress receipts and OPS3.NO_MATERIAL_PROGRESS stall classification.
